items.title: Oscar "Chicken" Henry Interview, 1959-07-11
items.q: Armstrong and the other fellow in Chicago, Mitchell, used the Harry B.J.

ctx.x: Oh, let me look at it. Can I see the bell? I've never, you know, never seen one of those horns close by. Several people told me they used those horns. Armstrong and the other fellow in Chicago, Mitchell, used the Harry B.J. But I've never had my hands on one of them. Oh, that's fine. It's pretty good. So that's a Harry B.J., a silver-plated trombone. It has a small bell. Any number on the mouthpiece? Five. Number five? You know that, huh? You know what kind of a mouthpiece it is, huh? I think this is five. Oh,…
